human_somite_organoid_specimen.species: Vertebrate paraxial mesoderm / somite embryo dorsal SEM (transferred as structural reference for human pluripotent stem-cell somite organoid / axioloid metameric somite periodicity)

hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.section: Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118; Matsuda et al. (2020) Science 369:1450-1455; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2023) Nature 613:550-557
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.mrna_dde: dm/dt = alpha_m / (1 + (p(t - tau_tx) / K)^n) - delta_m * m(t)
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.protein_dde: dp/dt = alpha_p * m(t - tau_tl) - delta_p * p(t)
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.half_life_degradation_relation: delta_m = ln(2) / t_half_m,  delta_p = ln(2) / t_half_p
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.exact_time_rescaling_invariance_law: Under t -> lambda * t, tau -> lambda * tau, delta_m -> delta_m / lambda, delta_p -> delta_p / lambda, alpha_m -> alpha_m / lambda, alpha_p -> alpha_p / lambda, the HES7 DDE is strictly invariant and oscillation period scales as T_osc(lambda) = lambda * T_osc(1) with lambda_human_mouse = 300 / 120 = 2.50
hes7_delayed_oscillator_governing_equati.metabolic_nad_nadh_scaling_law: k_met(R_NAD) = (R_NAD / R_NAD_ref)^gamma_met,  delta_m,p(R_NAD) = k_met * delta_m,p_0,  tau(R_NAD) = tau_0 / k_met  =>  T_osc(R_NAD) = T_osc_0 / k_met(R_NAD)

mouse_wt.species: Mus musculus (in vitro PSM / iPSC-derived presomitic mesoderm)

human_wt.species: Homo sapiens (hPSC-derived PSM / HES7-Achilles reporter & Axioloid)

matsuda_diazcuadros_perturbation_series.source: Matsuda et al. (2020) Science 369:1450-1455 Figs. 1-4; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118 Figs. 2-4; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2023) Nature 613:550-557 Figs. 1-4

regimes.label: Mouse PSM + human hHES7 locus knock-in swap (Matsuda 2020 Fig. 2)
Human PSM + LbNOX expression (elevated cytosolic NAD+/NADH accelerates translation, Diaz-Cuadros 2023 Fig. 4)
Human PSM + Sodium Azide / Rotenone Complex I/IV ETC inhibition (Diaz-Cuadros 2023 Fig. 2)
Intronless Hes7 Delta-intron1-3 ablation (tau_splicing = 0 -> subcritical delay collapse, Matsuda 2020 / Takashima 2011)
